function.name: search_listings
function.description: Search the agency's active listings. Use this before stating any fact about a property: price, bedrooms, availability, pets, parking. Never answer listing questions from memory.

query.description: Free-text description, e.g. 'pet friendly apartment near the station'.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price (sale price, or monthly rent).

propertyType.description: e.g. apartment, house, condo, townhouse, studio.

listingRef.description: A listing id or street address the caller mentioned.
